title: Associate Handbag Designer
note: Open to candidates with 1–2 years of experience or a relevant internship in accessories or fashion design.

facts.summary: Associate designer on DNAM Brands' accessories team (brands include Von Dutch and Ed Hardy).
facts.duties: Help create tech packs, sketches and colorways; update Illustrator CADs; build line sheets in Miro/Figma; coordinate samples and revisions; research trends and materials; prep production POs and costing.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in fashion design or related; 1–2 years or internship; handbag materials/construction knowledge; advanced Illustrator and Photoshop; able to work on-site in Beverly Hills.
